name: io.github.herp75/migros-mcp
description: Migros Switzerland: products, stores, recipes; with login basket, lists, orders, Cumulus

environmentVariables.name: MIGROS_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Migros login e-mail (leave out to only use the tools without an account)

environmentVariables.name: MIGROS_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Migros password (use one you use nowhere else)

environmentVariables.name: MIGROS_TOTP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: 2FA setup key, so no code is ever asked for (works like a second password)
